attacker_monitors_mempool_observed.meaning: attacker is monitoring the public mempool for liquidity-addition transactions

liquidity_addition_pending_observed.meaning: a transaction calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange to add liquidity is pending

deadline_equals_block_timestamp.meaning: the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call uses block.timestamp as its deadline so no delay mechanism applies

liquidity_value_received.meaning: liquidity value the protocol receives for the assets it provided in the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call

liquidity_value_expected.meaning: liquidity value corresponding to the assets the protocol provided, absent manipulable surrounding pool-price changes
liquidity_value_expected.checkpoint: derived reference for the liquidity addition

assets_provided.meaning: assets the protocol provided in the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call

assumptions: The protocol's provided assets and the fair liquidity value are fixed for the pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call.
The attacker's surrounding pool-price manipulation is the only source of deviation between received and expected liquidity value.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of the expected liquidity value corresponding to the provided assets, so liquidity_value_expected is bound only to the provided-asset quantity as a symbolic reference.
Report does not state who may call increaseLiquidityCurrentRange or any authorization condition.

limitations: Expected liquidity value is a symbolic reference; no concrete amounts or prices are supplied.
The steady drain is formalized as a per-call received-below-expected relation; cumulative drain across repeated attacks is not separately quantified.
Whether the sandwich is executed and profitable is described as potential, not observed.
